Settings

Shared with everyone who edits this site (committed to its own repo) - nothing here should be secret, since that repo has to be treated as though it's public even when it isn't.

Inserted image sizes
Web standard High detail Post internal

"Post internal" is for an image meant to float left/right with text wrapping around it - small enough that the float actually reads as a photo next to a paragraph, not a full-width image.

Image uploads (Cloudflare R2 bucket)

Which bucket this site uploads shared images to. Each person still needs their own credentials (see "This installation") to actually use it.

Public URL base needs the scheme (starts with "https://" or "http://") - this is fetched directly by a browser, not passed through the site. If you save without one, "https://" is added for you.

Makes the preview reachable from other devices on your network (e.g. a phone) instead of only this machine. Restarts the preview if it's already running.

Author

Added to a page's contributor list on every save. Leave blank to skip attribution entirely.

Image uploads - your credentials

Personal to this installation - never shared or committed with the site.

GitHub sync

Personal to this installation - never shared or committed with the site. Leave the token blank if you already sync over SSH (e.g. an SSH key set up on this machine); set one to sync over HTTPS instead.

A token is also required to look at someone else's draft from Local Drafts, even if you use SSH for your own syncing - that list comes directly from GitHub's website, which has no SSH equivalent.

Create a fine-grained token scoped to just this repository, with "Contents" read and write access, from GitHub's own token settings help.

Used only to tell your own pull requests apart from everyone else's when reviewing someone else's work.

New post

Page date & time

Controls sort order for dated content (like blog posts). Use this instead of typing a date by hand in the text - a badly-formatted date can fail the entire site's build, not just this page.

Rename page

Changes this page's title and web address. Doesn't move it to a different section.

Local drafts

A draft is a local branch - its own independent copy of the site to edit without touching the live site until you're ready.

Review a pull request

Read-only - you can't edit while reviewing. Needs a repository connected in Settings → GitHub sync.

Review changes

Everything changed since the last save point. Committing saves this as a checkpoint you can always come back to.

Resize image

Shrinks the actual image file on disk and overwrites it. This can't be undone, and the image can't be made bigger again afterward.

Insert image from a web link

Links to the image where it already lives - nothing is downloaded or stored in this site. If that page ever goes away, the image stops showing here too.
